info.name: FLeetX API Collection
info.description:
Complete, enterprise-grade Postman Test Collection for FLeetX Intelligent Fleet Management System backend API.

Authoritative Source: Backend Route Definitions (`routes/api.php`) and RBAC Gate Definitions (`AppServiceProvider.php`).
Includes full authentication flows, dynamic token extraction, multi-role testing, ID propagation, negative validation assertions, and collection runner compatibility.
